remarks: Charming & Newer 4th Floor Apartment in Modern Mid-Rise Building offers flexible floor plan with stylish details! This newer, pet friendly apartment features contemporary design & a variety of amenities to complement your life! Located on the brim of exciting downtown Stamford, close to UCONN + public golf course, in a secure, well managed community, residents will enjoy a gourmet kitchen, fully equipped with granite & stainless, a breakfast bar, dining area/living space, a sparkling full bath with subway tile, in-unit laundry, on-site 24-hour security, reserved garage parking for 1-car, a well-appointed fitness center and awesome rooftop deck to take in the outdoors and enjoy panoramic cityscape views. Adding to the features is a 5-star energy rating and absolutely NO ADD-ON FEES!  Interested applicants must complete a Park 215 Application uploaded in supplements and credit check through Apply Connect only. Pets are welcome at Park 215, here are the limits: 1 dog - 35lbs, 2 cats, or 1 dog and 1 cat OK. Park 215 is a no smoking community.
